title: When the Boss on the Phone Isn’t Real: How More Than $129 Million Was Stolen Using A.I.
summary: A federal indictment alleges that three men used generative A.I. to impersonate voices of chief executives and lawyers to defraud companies of millions of dollars.
body_markdown: A federal indictment alleges that three men used generative A.I. to impersonate voices of chief executives and lawyers to defraud companies of millions of dollars.
